name: Welcome to Tapiaca
source:
Imagine a perfect day: you've finished college with honors and the world seems to be at your feet. But everything changes when you discover that your father is gravely ill. In his final moments, he reveals a secret that will turn your life upside down... and take you to Tapiaca, a town full of secrets, challenges, and unexpected opportunities.

In this city, you will not only face threats from gangs and criminals, but you will also have the opportunity to run your own business designing and selling exclusive clothing. 
Grow your company to earn money and improve your situation while you strive to survive in a hostile environment and protect those you love. With simple gameplay and an easy-to-navigate interface, you will have a series of crucial choices at hand that will determine your destiny.

[From [url=https://chrisnu-visual-novel.itch.io/welcometotapiaca]Itch.io[/url]]
